Board of Parole and Post-Prison Supervision,
Respondent.
Court of Appeals No. A187078
ORDER REACTIVATING JUDICIAL REVIEW; VACATING AND REMANDING;
APPELLATE JUDGMENT
Before Egan, Presiding Judge, and Joyce, Judge.
Petitioner, in an unopposed motion, moves the court to vacate the board’s final
order setting petitioner’s sex offender notification level and remand the case.1 Petitioner
represents that the board does not object to the motion. The case, which was held in
abeyance, is reactivated, and the motion is granted.
The court agrees with the parties that the proper disposition of this case is to
vacate the board’s order and remand for a new assessment of petitioner’s sex offender
notification level, pursuant to Harless v. Board of Parole, 348 Or App 289, ___ P3d ___
(2026). Further, despite the request that the particular dispositional wording differ from
Harless, because the appropriate outcome under Harless is vacating and remanding the
board’s order, the court utilizes the same dispositional wording as articulated in
Harless. Overall, the court agrees with the identification of error and that summary
disposition is appropriate in this case.
Vacated and remanded.
James C. Egan
Presiding Judge
6/1/2026
1 A copy of the motion, for the board’s review, is available on the court’s Appellate
Case Management System (ACMS).
